firmware.note: CircuitPython on the board, fox-bench's foxlib and a network-fox template (Wi-Fi beacon, Wi-Fi probe, BLE beacon, puzzle beacon, checkpoint) deployed over the REPL, as source or precompiled .mpy. The SoC's own radio: no module. All five templates on the bench on the XIAO ESP32C6 2026-11-23 with 114-156 KB free after init, found by the laptop, the checkpoint's sign-in page and find log included (docs/hardware-log.md). The 802.15.4 radio is unused.
